$comment: The tool-data format Agent Link reads (agentlink/tooldata.py). One file per add-on: <package>/data/tools.json.

heavy.description: A long job: queued, timed, given a deadline.

writes.description: Its path is a file it writes, not reads.

pathIsCurve.description: Its path is a curve in the model, not a file.

runner.description: Agent Link's own tools only: the runner (agentlink/runners.py) that runs this wrapper. Add-ons bind handlers instead.

target.description: Agent Link only: what the runner runs (maker or type, method, command, or what to read).

args.description: Agent Link only: each argument's default, conversion, family helper, property or step after the object is made.

rules.description: Agent Link only: the checks the handler made, each with its refusal message word for word.

answer.description: Agent Link only: the answer's fields and the family helper that finishes it.
